discovery.title: Menya moderi Novera
discovery.estimated: Gereranya kuri 8.192 ibimenyetso; guhuza moteri bigomba kugenzurwa.
discovery.benchmarkNote: Amanota yabatangaza akoresha uburyo butandukanye; ntibashyira kurutonde rwamadosiye GGUF kurwego rumwe.
discovery.testHint: Kuramo hanyuma ukore icyitegererezo mbere. Ikizamini cyaho: kugeza ku bimenyetso 128. Iyinjiza ikubiyemo ikibazo; kwibuka ni kuri sisitemu yose.

catalog.title: Shakisha AI hamwe na Novera
catalog.subtitle: Menya icyitegererezo ukoresheje, genzura ibyo usabwa hanyuma uhitemo ibyuma byawe.
catalog.preparedNote: Reba kuri AI zose. Imirimo imwe isaba moteri ikiri guhuzwa.
catalog.catalogError: Ubuvumbuzi bwa Live ntibushobora kuboneka. Moderi zipakiye mbere zikomeza kuboneka.
catalog.tight: Ububiko buke cyangwa CPU gusubira inyuma
catalog.estimateNote: Ikigereranyo kirimo uburemere, imiterere hamwe nububiko. Imikorere, umwanya wa disiki yubusa hamwe nububiko buracyakeneye kugenzurwa.
catalog.pythonNote: Irasaba Python / PyTorch ibidukikije. Kuzana ububiko bwuzuye muri Safetensors / Transformers. Gukoresha GPU bisaba kubaka CUDA.
catalog.medicalNote: Iyemezwa rya Clinical ntabwo ryasuzumwe na Novera.
catalog.metadataMissing: Metadata imwe ntishobora kugenzurwa. Ongera usuzume isoko yicyitegererezo mbere yo gukuramo.
catalog.acknowledge: Nasuzumye ibigereranyo hamwe na cheque zisigaye zihuza.
catalog.advisorNote: Ibitekerezo bibarwa mugace ka metadata no kugereranya kwibuka. Imikorere iracyakeneye gupimwa.
catalog.reasonReady: Moteri ihuriweho hamwe no kugereranya neza kwibuka.
catalog.reasonRecent: Vuba aha ivugururwa ukurikije metadata yamamaza.
catalog.reasonLanguage: Ururimi rwicyitegererezo rwatangajwe ruhuye nururimi rwawe.
catalog.tipLimited: Hitamo urumuri rworoshye cyangwa imvugo ngufi kugirango usige ububiko bwinshi buboneka.
catalog.tipRuntime: Kugenzura Python / PyTorch mbere yo kwishingikiriza kuri GPU.
catalog.tipFuture: Harakenewe moteri yinyongera mbere yuko iki gikorwa gishobora gukora muri Novera.
catalog.advisorEmpty: Nta ntangiriro iboneye ishobora gutoranywa muri metadata y'ubu.
catalog.hardwareUnknown: Amakuru yibikoresho arabura; ibyifuzo bikeneye amakuru RAM na GPU.
catalog.contextTip: Imvugo ngufi ikoresha ububiko buke idahinduye ingano yo gukuramo.
catalog.nvfp4Search: Blackwell GPU ifite ububiko buhagije bwamenyekanye buragaragara. Hitamo NVFP4 impinduka mugihe ubwubatsi na moteri ibashyigikiye. Kavukire FLUX.2 Klein 4B Gutwara ibintu neza birahari mumasoko yaho; reba CUDA PyTorch, kwishingikiriza kubushake, moderi ya mugenzi wawe hamwe nububiko bwubusa mbere yo gukuramo. Gutahura ibyuma ntibyemeza igihe cyagenwe cyangwa umuvuduko wubwishingizi.
catalog.nvfp4Prefer: NVFP4 irasabwa kuri uyu muryango wa GPU na FLUX.2 Klein 4B umuryango. Gutwara kavukire bisaba imiterere ya Comfy ishyigikiwe, CUDA PyTorch hamwe nubushake butemewe. Hitamo icyitegererezo cyishusho, kodegisi ya Qwen3 na VAE ukwayo muburyo bwo Kurema. Igihe cyagenwe, cyuzuye hamwe nububiko bwubusa buracyakeneye kugenzurwa.
catalog.nvfp4Check: NVFP4 yatahuwe: ubushobozi bwa GPU, kwibuka kubuntu, imiterere yuburemere cyangwa inkunga yububiko ntabwo byemewe. Reba moteri CUDA mbere yo guhitamo iyi variant. Imiterere yonyine ntabwo ishyiraho ubwuzuzanye.
catalog.nvfp4Unsupported: Kavukire NVFP4 ntabwo isabwa hamwe na GPU yamenyekanye cyangwa VRAM yubusa. Reba GGUF kubara cyangwa moteri ihuza. Iyo nzira ntabwo itanga kavukire FP4.
catalog.quantQualityAdvice: Novera GGUF kuyobora kubice byanditse, amashusho na videwo: Q6_K cyangwa irenga nibyo twatangiriyeho mugihe dushyira imbere ubudahemuka; Q4_K_M iringaniza ubuziranenge no kwibuka. Ibi nibyifuzo, ntabwo aribyukuri byukuri. Ibisubizo biterwa nurugero n'inshingano. NVFP4 hamwe nizindi gahunda zo kubara zikeneye guhuza kwabo no gusuzuma ubuziranenge.
